_comment: Promised vs delivered / Promis vs réalisé. Only pairs where BOTH the announced value and the actual (or latest official) value are stated in a cited source. Never estimate. type: cost|deadline|outcome. status: promised | in_progress | completed | delayed | unfulfilled (labels and definitions in _data/promise_status.json: promised = announced, no concrete step yet; in_progress = a bill, mandate letter, budget line or contract exists; completed = in force; delayed = past a date the government itself gave; unfulfilled = dropped or contradicted). EVERY item needs a sourced 'Why this status': status_evidence_en/fr + status_source_title/outlet/url/date (never inferred). updated: YYYY-MM-DD of the latest sourced change (cards sort by it, newest first). Optional party_en/fr for an election promise (e.g. 'PQ election promise'). Optional announced_lines / actual_lines: [{en, fr, source_title, source_outlet, source_url, date}] when one card compares several sourced figures; announced_en/fr and actual_en/fr stay as the one-line summary. Validate with `python3 _tools/plain.py --strict`.
